name: Zeroth Robotics
summary:
Zeroth Robotics is a consumer robotics brand operated by Suzhou JoyIn Intelligent Technology. It develops robots and AI systems intended to bring embodied intelligence into everyday life, with products spanning different physical forms and use cases. Its portfolio includes the Jupiter humanoid alongside other home and companion-oriented robotic platforms.

The company's approach connects robot hardware with AI and application development, emphasizing interactions and tasks in real-world environments. Its official materials position Zeroth around consumer robotics and the integration of robots into daily routines.
